title: Gibbs-state-weighted local root interaction envelope

parents.composition_rule: This is a separately versioned researcher-owned norm test. It does not edit PAH-001, PAH-OMC-004, PAH-OMC-008 or PAH-OMC-009.

exact_scope.carrier_family: The cofinal PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n for every integer n>=2, with the same neutral inclusions J_(n,n+1) and the same geometric root-support rule as PAH-OMC-009.
exact_scope.state_space: The displayed PAH-001 finite configuration space Omega_(rho,Q) with Q=1, K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, epsilon=1/2, and all five displayed couplings and beta=nu=1 fixed to one; R_max=R ranges over positive integers and tends to infinity.
exact_scope.functional: Exactly PAH-001 F_rho, with no added term, counterterm, parameter transport, averaging or rate modification.
exact_scope.state_weight: W_(n,R)(omega)=pi_(rho_R,Q)(omega)=Z_(n,R)^(-1) exp(-F_(rho_R)(omega)), the normalized positive Gibbs weight already declared by PAH-001 at beta=1.
exact_scope.observable_algebra: A_cyl is the algebraic union of bounded gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant cylinder observables generated by finitely many ell_v and closed-face holonomy characters. The R-488 coordinates (ell_a,ell_d,H_0,H_1) remain included.
exact_scope.norm: For bounded f on the finite invariant cylinder domain, ||f||_(2,W;n,R)^2=sum_(omega in Omega_(rho_R,Q)) W_(n,R)(omega)|f(omega)|^2. The common state-weighted norm is the family of these norms together with the root interaction seminorm below.
exact_scope.root_support: For every directed PAH root r, supp(r) is the maximal geometric vertex closure of every displayed PAH-001 energy term that can change under r: phase roots use the incident vertex star, aperture roots the closed two-cell star of the vertex, radial roots the closed two-cell stars of both endpoints, and link roots the closed two-cell star of the link and incident faces.
exact_scope.root_weight: w(r)=1+|supp(r)|. It is positive, geometric, state-independent and changes no PAH-001 rate.
exact_scope.local_interaction_sum: I_(n,R)(x)=sum_(r:x in supp(r)) w(r) sum_(omega in dom(r)) W_(n,R)(omega)c_r^(n,R)(omega), where c_r=m_r exp[-(F(r omega)-F(omega))/2] is the unchanged PAH-001 rate.
exact_scope.uniform_target: Prove or refute C_sw=sup_(R>=1) sup_(n>=2) sup_(x in V_n) I_(n,R)(x)<infinity.
exact_scope.common_core_input: If the root correspondence and eventual cylinder intertwining are supplied separately, a finite C_sw is the uniform state-weighted local interaction input for the common-core generator refinement. This contract does not identify the generator intertwining with the envelope alone.
exact_scope.observable_nonzero_rule: For every finite n and R, each R-488 generator ell_a, ell_d, H_0 and H_1 must have strictly positive ||.||_(2,W;n,R) norm; a weight that annihilates any one is rejected.

pre_registered_proof.conductance_lemma: For every directed root r, the inverse-pair bijection, 0<m_r<=1 and AM-GM give sum_omega W(omega)c_r(omega)<=1.
pre_registered_proof.geometric_lemma: Derive finite family-wide S_geom=sup_(n,r)|supp(r)| and N_geom=sup_(n,x)# {r:x in supp(r)} directly from the declared strip incidence; do not import a finite fixture.
pre_registered_proof.target_constant: C_sw=N_geom(1+S_geom), with N_geom and S_geom derived by the primary and independent geometry lanes before use.
pre_registered_proof.observable_lemma: Strict positivity of W on every finite state and explicit positive-weight R-488 witness states imply all four R-488 generator norms are nonzero.
pre_registered_proof.refinement_role: The envelope is accepted as a valid uniform local-form coefficient for common-core refinement only conditionally on a separately proved rootwise/eventual generator intertwining statement.

acceptance.primary: Compute S_geom and N_geom from every declared root type on the cofinal strip, verify the Gibbs conductance inequality by exact reversible pairing, derive C_sw and prove all four R-488 observable norms are positive.
acceptance.independent: Rebuild the state-weighted conductance bound and strip support/incidence counts without importing the primary implementation; reproduce S_geom, N_geom, C_sw and the nonzero-observable checks.
acceptance.hostile: Reject unnormalized or sign-reversed weights, a zero observable weight, a fixed-R_max restriction, omitted inverse roots, a mobility/rate change, counterterms and any promotion of the conditional common-core input to an intertwining theorem.
acceptance.formal: Lean checks the exact AM-GM conductance inequality, positive norm witnesses, geometric constant arithmetic and the no-physics firewall. It is not a continuum or physical theorem.

known_boundaries.scope: The regulator path fixes K, M_s, M_psi, epsilon, beta, nu and all displayed couplings to the declared unit values; only strip level n and R_max=R are uniformized.
known_boundaries.negative_predecessor: R-489 rejects the unweighted sup-state envelope, not this Gibbs-state-weighted conductance envelope.
known_boundaries.intertwining: A finite weighted envelope does not prove L_(n+1)I_(n,n+1)=I_(n,n+1)L_n; that remains a separate common-core question.
known_boundaries.no_physics: No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.

falsifiers: Any parent source hash differs from the pins.
The weight is not exactly the normalized PAH-001 Gibbs state or is not strictly positive on every finite state.
An exact directed-root conductance exceeds one after inverse pairing, or the geometric S_geom/N_geom bound fails for some n.
Any R-488 generator has zero state-weighted norm on a finite member of the family.
The proof uses a fixed R_max truncation, counterterm, averaging map, rate refit, or an unregistered parameter change.
The finite envelope is promoted to generator intertwining or physical theory without its separate proof.
non_claims: PAH-OMC-010 is a researcher-owned norm contract, not an external source or physical authority.
A positive state-weighted envelope does not retroactively repair the R-489 unweighted sup-state no-go.
A finite C_sw is only a uniform local-form input; it does not prove eventual generator intertwining, an infinite-volume automorphism or an ordered limit.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
single_next_question: Does the exact PAH-001 Gibbs-state-weighted local interaction sum have a family-wide finite C_sw while all R-488 observables retain positive weighted norm?
revisit_condition: Reopen only if a parent hash, the declared Gibbs weight, the cofinal strip, the geometric support rule or the regulator scope changes, or if a separate rootwise intertwining proof is supplied.
